basic_details.job_title: DRDO SSPL Paid Internship Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for 65 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO), Solid State Physics Laboratory (SSPL) Paid Internship Notification 2026 has been released on 29.07.2026 on the official website https://drdo.gov.in. A total of 65 internship vacancies have been announced through the DRDO SSPL Paid Internship 2026.

salary_details.pay_scale: ₹5,000/- (Fixed), for candidates completing the full 6-month duration
salary_details.details: Monthly stipend: ₹5,000/- (Fixed), applicable only to candidates who undertake the full 6-month internship. Stipend is paid in two equal installments of ₹15,000/- each - the first after completion of 3 months, and the second after completion of 6 months - via electronic transfer. A minimum of 15 days' attendance in a month is required for that month to count toward the stipend calculation. Interns joining for a shorter duration (less than 6 months, minimum 4 weeks) are not eligible for the stipend. Expenses such as lodging, boarding, transport, and medical costs are to be borne by the candidate.

selection_process: Selection will be made through screening and/or interview-based selection
as stated in the notification. No further breakdown of the screening/interview process is provided.
how_to_apply: The application process is offline only - there is no online application portal mentioned in the notification. Follow these steps:
Download/prepare the application form as per the format given in the official notification.
Fill in all required details: name, father's/husband's name, date of birth, address, category, educational qualifications, and experience (if any).
Attach the Character Certificate and the Recommendation Letter/NOC from your institute (on institute letterhead, with the internship start date mentioned).
Attach self-attested photocopies of all relevant documents and affix a recent passport-size photograph.
Send the complete application by post to the address below, on or before 30 September 2026:
Postal Address: Director, SSPL, Kind Attention: HRD, SSPL, DRDO, Lucknow Road, Timarpur, Delhi - 110054
Candidates should apply through their respective institutes, in coordination with the concerned DRDO laboratory, as mentioned in the notification.
important_instructions: Internship duration ranges from a minimum of 4 weeks to a maximum of 6 months; only those completing the full 6 months are eligible for the stipend. Interns may request an extension of their internship period, subject to the overall 6-month limit; such requests will be reviewed by the laboratory based on financial and infrastructure feasibility. Interns will be bound by the provisions of the Indian Official Secrets Act, 1923, and DRDO's rules and regulations, and will only be granted access to non-classified areas. Interns must not disclose or publish any restricted/confidential DRDO-related information on any platform, including newspapers, periodicals, or social media. Any breach of security rules or laboratory regulations may lead to termination of the internship without notice. DRDO will not be responsible for any injuries sustained during the internship period. Candidates are responsible for the careful handling of any equipment provided and may be liable to compensate for damage. No leave, except sick leave (with valid prescription), will be granted; applicable gazetted/closed holidays of the laboratory will apply. Completion of the internship does not guarantee employment at DRDO.

Candidates pursuing degrees in Physics, Electronics, or Material Science can also explore more Engineering Government Internships and DRDO Recruitment Notifications across various laboratories. Students looking for similar research-based opportunities can check the latest Delhi Government Jobs and Central Government Internships 2026. Those holding a B.Tech./M.Sc. degree in relevant streams can also browse more Defence Sector Jobs and Research Fellow Positions matching their qualification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DRDO SSPL Paid Internship 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application by post is 30 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in the DRDO SSPL Internship 2026?
faq.answer: There are 65 vacancies notified for this paid internship.

faq.question: Q3. What is the stipend for the DRDO SSPL Internship 2026?
faq.answer: The stipend is ₹5,000/- per month (fixed), paid in two installments of ₹15,000/- each, applicable only to candidates completing the full 6-month internship.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible to apply for the DRDO SSPL Internship 2026?
faq.answer: Only final-year (last semester) students pursuing B.E./B.Tech. or M.Sc./M.Tech. in Physics, Chemistry, Electronics, Electrical, Material Science, Quantum Technology, Laser Optics, Semiconductor Device, or equivalent disciplines are eligible.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for the DRDO SSPL Internship 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Can I apply for the DRDO SSPL Internship online?
faq.answer: No online application mode has been mentioned. Applications must be sent by post through the candidate's institute.

faq.question: Q7. What documents are required for the DRDO SSPL Internship application?
faq.answer: A duly filled application form, character certificate, recommendation letter/NOC from the institute, self-attested document copies, and a passport-size photograph are required.
